title: Elon Musk Says AI Could Master Every Field By 2028
description: Elon Musk has predicted that artificial intelligence could outperform humans across all fields by the end of 2027 or 2028. Experts note that AI’s growing role in research does not necessarily mean complete mastery of every discipline.
